pr_body:
This PR adds support for `ON TRUE` (and arbitrary expressions that constantly evaluate to `true`) in left outer joins.

```sql
WITH t AS (
  SELECT 1 AS r, [{n:1}, {n:2}] AS s
  UNION
  SELECT 2 AS r, [{n:3}, {n:4}] AS s
)
SELECT r, s1.s.n FROM t
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(s) AS s1(s) ON TRUE
ORDER BY 1, 2
----
1	1
1	2
2	3
2	4
```

It fixes #7391 by simplifying the provided workaround.

issue_context.title: LEFT JOIN UNNEST() requires an ON clause
issue_context.body:
### What happens?

Sometimes you want to UNNEST with a LEFT JOIN.  Currently you have to provide an ON clause in order to do this.  I have a hacky workaround that I would like to remove.



### To Reproduce

```
with t as (
  select 
    1 as r, 
    [
      {n:1},
      {n:2}
    ] as s
  union   select 
    2 as r, 
    [
      {n:3},
      {n:4}
    ] as s
     
)
select r, s1.s.n from t
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(s) as s1(s)
```

### OS:

linux

### DuckDB Version:

current

### DuckDB Client:

web shell

### Full Name:

lloyd tabb

### Affiliation:

google

### Have you tried this on the latest `master` branch?

- [X] I agree

- [X] I agree
comments:
Here are the basic permutation I think are interesting.  Assume a table with two columns, a scalar and an array.

```
with t as (
  SELECT 1 as r, ARRAY[1,2,3] as a
  UNION SELECT 2 as r, ARRAY[4] as a
  UNION SELECT 3 as r, NULL as a
)
SELECT r, a.value
FROM t 
, UNNEST(a) as a(value)
```
Returns no results.  UNNEST(NULL) basically eats everything.  Maybe this is should be an error.  (I think it is in BigQuery).

The Query below is  an inner join and eliminates row where r=4.
```
with t as (
  SELECT 1 as r, ARRAY[1,2,3] as a
  UNION SELECT 2 as r, ARRAY[4] as a
  UNION SELECT 4 as r, [] as a
)
SELECT r, a.value
FROM t 
, UNNEST(a) as a(value)
```

```
{"r":1,"value":3}
{"r":2,"value":4}
{"r":1,"value":2}
{"r":1,"value":1}
```

We get an error without an ON clause but the behaviour is a left join (the r=4 is retained) 
```
with t as (
  SELECT 1 as r, ARRAY[1,2,3] as a
  UNION SELECT 2 as r, ARRAY[4] as a
  UNION SELECT 4 as r, [] as a
)
SELECT r, a.value
FROM t 
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(a) as a(value) 
   ON a.value is NULL or a.value IS NOT NULL
```

r | value
-- | --
2 | 4
1 | 3
1 | 2
1 | 1
4 | NULL

https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/7821 adds support for `ON TRUE` in left outer joins.

I am currently also fixing the `UNNEST(NULL)` example because this is a bug. Will have a PR open soon, so that we get this into the next bug fix release.
```sql
# this should return four rows
with t as (
  SELECT 1 as r, ARRAY[1,2,3] as a
  UNION SELECT 2 as r, ARRAY[4] as a
  UNION SELECT 3 as r, NULL as a
)
SELECT r, a.value
FROM t 
, UNNEST(a) as a(value)
----
1	1
1	2
1	3
2	4
```
